+class ResponseCache:
+    """On-disk store of raw LLM responses under one root directory."""
+
+    def __init__(self, root: Path) -> None:
+        self.root = root
+
+    def _path(self, monitor: Monitor, transcript: Transcript) -> Path:
+        return self.root / f"{cache_key(monitor, transcript)}.json"
+
+    def get(self, monitor: Monitor, transcript: Transcript) -> LLMResponse | None:
+        """Load the cached response, treating a missing or corrupt file as a miss."""
+        try:
+            path = self._path(monitor, transcript)
+            return LLMResponse.model_validate_json(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        except (OSError, ValueError, ValidationError):
+            return None
+
+    def put(self, monitor: Monitor, transcript: Transcript, response: LLMResponse) -> None:
+        """Store one response, creating the root on first write."""
+        self.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
